name: print-social-violet-teaser-countdown-post-grid
title: Nine violet launch teaser posts with countdown, mic and dark phone screens
whatItIs: A 3x3 grid of square rounded posts on violet with a small logo at each top. They include a flip-clock countdown '3 2 1', a Spotify-powered UI, dark phone screens with green accents, a chrome 3D microphone with avatars, a portrait of a man with headphones and a black 'Something exciting is on the way!' card.
whatItMeans: Hype and community energy; violet plus dark screens feel like music and nightlife.
techniques: Build teaser posts around a countdown clock graphic.
Keep one background violet with wavy texture for all posts.
Alternate device mockups with a hero object and a portrait.
Use a single black post in the grid as a pause.

vocabulary.definition: A countdown numeral style with split cards.
A post hinting at a coming launch.
Subtle curved shapes in a background.
A darker post breaking the grid rhythm.
